body:
Greg direction as relayed by Engram::Advisor/session6219 to Termal::Architect2/session8983 in mailbox-message-6c42c13a-43ae-4f6f-a373-7114589580cc (#66, 2026-10-07T03:07:16Z): 'every rejected request must return a usable reason. The requester must either be able to correct and retry safely, or see the actual class of error.' Apply first to canonical w-a776ab739655: stable safely redacted machine-readable reason, requester-facing remedy/retry guidance, durable correlation/decision locator. Never expose secrets/broad raw environment, invent an unknown cause or disguise a sensitive cause as a different error; non-disclosable class plus safe next action is appropriate. Roles remain harness-agnostic under Greg's 2026-10-06 direction. Design and independent concurrence precede implementation. Proposed exact contract7e14504a2a7e460bbe0ac97122ad1e9c is not yet independently concurred or implemented. This direction adds diagnostic design work; it does not resolve missing historical evidence for child11265 or authorize approval bypass.

Greg clarification relayed by Advisor69, mailbox-message-c6843911-307d-47d3-bcb7-350e7804b13c (2026-10-07T03:14:57Z): for MCP, rejection must be returned in the response to that SAME request as a structured safely redacted error with remedy. Parent log, reverse update, later lookup, concurrent prompt, ignored metadata or separate notification are noncompliant substitutes; durable lookup is diagnostic only. If ACP/host intercepts before MCP response, repair the actual host response path without replacing the requirement by a negotiated extension/bootstrap workaround. This supersedes the alternative requester channels in v1/v2 proposals; complete v3 proposal8860eb6d9d054c23af6935845c4de797 selects a host-owned MCP admission broker and ordinary same-call error response, pending independent contract/identity/conformance check. No implementation or installed-adapter proof is implied.
